user.title: Connect to a local LP365-P
user.description: Reads local status only. Close phone apps while connecting. Confirm volume scaling against your app before enabling consumption and flow entities. Set pressure multiplier to 0 to show only its raw reading; 0.1 converts this verified LP365-P firmware's reading to psi.

data.verified_volume: I have verified volume units and scaling against the app
data.pressure_factor: Raw pressure to psi multiplier (0 disables pressure entity)

error.invalid_key: Use the 16-byte local encryption key, not the Virtual ID.
error.cannot_connect: No valid local status response. Check IP, key and protocol, and close other local connections.

init.title: Water meter cost comparison
init.description: Indicative household comparison using recorded full days. Enter your actual annual unmetered bill; 0 means unknown. Welsh Water presets are for standard household tariffs. Only choose the surface-water rebate if it has been approved. Automatic updates check the maintained GitHub tariff catalogue daily, not a supplier live feed. Custom suppliers require manual rates. Missing or expired tariffs never produce estimates.

data.annual_unmetered_bill: Current annual unmetered bill (£; 0 if unknown)

custom.title: Custom region / supplier tariff
custom.description: Enter standard household rates from your supplier’s dated bill or tariff. These custom rates are manual and do not update automatically. Standing charge must be the combined annual water/sewerage charge.

data.custom_sewer_rate: Sewerage (£ per m³ before return allowance)

error.invalid_tariff_date: Enter a current or future tariff end date.
error.invalid_number: Enter finite, non-negative amounts within the stated limits.
